messages:
maya (ML Eng): quick geo sweep summary — A100 vs H100 on a handful of open 7B/6B models. pasted the high-level numbers below (prefill/decode p50/p95, toks/sec, $/1M). TL;DR: H100 wins on tokens/sec and $/1M in US/APAC, EU shows a decode p95 regression on H100 that looks like a kernel fallback/thermal effect.

maya (ML Eng): ```
model           gpu   region   prefill_p50  prefill_p95  decode_p50  decode_p95  toks_sec  $/1M_tokens
Mistral-7B      A100  us-west  48ms         120ms        6ms         18ms        9,200     $12.6
Mistral-7B      H100  us-west  34ms         88ms         4ms         12ms        13,400    $8.7
Mistral-7B      A100  eu-west  52ms         130ms        7ms         20ms        8,800     $14.0
Mistral-7B      H100  eu-west  40ms         220ms        5ms         48ms        9,500     $11.8
Llama2-7B-chat  A100  ap-southeast 60ms      150ms        8ms         25ms        7,900     $15.7
Llama2-7B-chat  H100  ap-southeast 42ms      98ms         5ms         16ms        12,000    $9.8
GPT-J-6B        A100  us-west  38ms         95ms         5ms         16ms        10,800    $10.7
GPT-J-6B        H100  us-west  26ms         72ms         3ms         10ms        15,600    $7.4
```

maya (ML Eng): notes — all runs used the same quant profile (q4_0) except one A100 control with q8_0. kernels: tiled_attention_v2 on H100 where available, fallback to tiled_attention_v1 on older builds. batch=1, seq=1024 synthetic conversational traces. cost calc = spot GPU rate + infra overhead.

jon (Infra): nice, thanks. can you upload raw CSVs + perf counters? curious about GPU utilization and SM stall metrics for eu-west H100.

maya (ML Eng): uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/3357921111/ — CSV + flamegraphs + run-metadata.json. bench-bot: run 3357921111 artifacts available at s3://redwood-bench/3357921111/ (uploaded by maya) :white_check_mark:

siya (Research): the eu-west H100 decode_p95 (48ms) stands out. from the flamegraphs looks like attention kernel dropped to an older path (~xformers fallback) mid-run. could be a driver/kernel mismatch in that AMI. did we run same container tag across regions?

maya (ML Eng): yes same container tag. infra differences: eu-west uses older CUDA 12.1 node image vs us/apac on 12.5. suspect runtime fallback there.

elliot (SRE): thermal/clock scaling could amplify p95. eu-west cluster had sustained load yesterday; some nodes reported lower clock governors. recommend a quick micro-run: H100 eu-west with newer kernel + isolate gpu core freq fixed. if reproduce, escalate to infra.

siya (Research): also want to try q8x4 on A100 (saw decent quality tradeoff) and q5* hybrids on H100 for cost parity. may reduce prefill overhead too.

maya (ML Eng): plan: 1) re-run H100 eu-west with CUDA 12.5 image + tiled_attention_v2 build, 2) run A100 q8x4 vs q4_0 for Mistral-7B conversation trace, 3) produce toks/sec and $/1M diff. target EOD.

jon (Infra): if you need a clean node I'll provision a fresh pool (no noisy neighbors) — say so and I’ll tag it.

maya (ML Eng): please do, tagged: 'bench-iso-335792' — thanks.

elliot (SRE): small ask — include p99 for decode in next run, p95 can hide long tails for short seqs.

maya (ML Eng): will add p99. will also capture kernel selection logs and nvprof traces.

siya (Research): awesome. once re-run is done I’ll run a small quality eval (hallucination token rate + prompt response coherence) for q8x4 on A100 to verify no regressions.

maya (ML Eng): perfect. will post updated table when runs complete. :rocket:
